summary.text: Shenea Booth is the Democratic candidate for the Nevada State Assembly, District 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Melissa Hardy (R).
A small business owner, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is a Henderson resident and a founder of the Circus Arts Guild of America.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Shenea Booth described herself as a Henderson resident, small business owner and two-time world champion acrobatic gymnast.

She said she founded the Circus Arts Guild of America and hosts the Circuspreneur Podcast, and that she has advocated for labor protections, workplace safety, fair pay and union rights for entertainers and independent workers.
Booth advanced from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary for District 22.
She listed housing affordability, worker and union rights, small business development, education, and support for veterans and seniors among her policy interests.
